prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop web app comp, landscape approximately 1440×1000
Primary request: Redesign the logged-in home page of “서울 촌놈”, a private travel-memory archive used repeatedly by one couple. Direction name: 여행 서가. This is a fast retrieval tool: a dense newest-first journey index on the left and the selected journey’s photograph and review on the right. Travel and day-out records are not merged; travel is the main view, day-outs are a clearly separate secondary destination.
Input image: existing Seoul Chonnom screen, reference for warm-paper palette, restrained Seoul Pink accent, Korean workhorse sans typography and quiet product character only. Do not carry over its floating pill desktop header, narrow mobile-like central column, placeholder illustration content, or current layout.
Structure: compact flat desktop header with supplied SLCN mark area and only Home, 여행, 나들이, 달력 as primary destinations; shoes and Film Art live under a quiet secondary more/profile destination. Below, a heading “지난 여행” and small “만난 지 653일째”. Split the working area into exactly two panes with one hairline: left about 38% width is a dense archive index with an understated rectangular search, year jump labels, and newest-first rows for “속초 2박 3일”, “부산, 비 오는 주말”, “제주 겨울”, “강릉의 늦여름”, each with date, region and duration. Right about 62% is the selected “속초 2박 3일” memory: one large unboxed photograph, title, date range, region, one-line review “바다와 시장 사이를 오래 걸었던 여름 여행.” and a quiet text action “기록 열기”. Selection is marked by a slim Seoul Pink rule and weight change, not a filled card. No third column and no cards.
Style: calm, precise, mature production interface refined over years; warm paper #FFF8F8, ink #1B1B1B, white, Seoul Pink #FE9FC8 used sparingly, muted rose gray. Pretendard-like Korean sans throughout. Flat content surfaces, hairline rules, high but differentiated information density, photos as memory evidence. No glass on desktop.
Constraints: readable Korean UI, actual app surface not a landing page. No 3-column feature cards, no card grid, no nested cards, no excessive pills, no icon tile plus heading plus description, no purple or blue gradient, no large gradient hero, no uniform section spacing, no decorative shadow, no glow, no glass desktop shell, no marketing copy, no metrics dashboard.
